# Design System Rules
# Auto-generated by `project-dna` skill from UI-SPEC.md.
# Enforces design consistency across all UI components.

## Component Library

**Library:** [e.g., shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS v3 / Material UI v5 / Custom]
**Rationale:** [Why this library was chosen]

### Usage Rules
- Use existing components from the library before creating custom ones
- Custom components must follow the same API conventions (props, variants, composition)
- Never override library styles directly — extend via the design token system

---

## Typography

**Primary font:** [e.g., Inter] — body text, UI labels
**Code font:** [e.g., JetBrains Mono] — code blocks, monospace

### Scale
| Token | Size | Line Height | Weight | Use |
|-------|------|-------------|--------|-----|
| `text-xs` | 12px | 16px | 400 | Captions, labels |
| `text-sm` | 14px | 20px | 400 | Secondary text, metadata |
| `text-base` | 16px | 24px | 400 | Body text (default) |
| `text-lg` | 18px | 28px | 400 | Lead text |
| `text-xl` | 20px | 28px | 600 | Small headings |
| `text-2xl` | 24px | 32px | 600 | Section headings |
| `text-3xl` | 30px | 36px | 700 | Page headings |
| `text-4xl` | 36px | 40px | 700 | Hero headings |

### Rules
- Body text: always `text-base` (16px) or larger — never use `text-xs` for main content
- Headings: use semantic HTML (`<h1>`-`<h6>`) — do not fake headings with large text
- Line length: maximum 75 characters for reading text (apply `max-w-prose`)
- Font loading: preload critical fonts, use `font-display: swap`

### Color Rules
- Never use raw hex values in components — always use design tokens
- Dark mode: each semantic token must have a dark variant defined
- Never use color as the sole differentiator (always pair with icon, label, or pattern for accessibility)

## Spacing System

**Base unit:** [4px / 8px] — all spacing values are multiples of this unit

| Token | Value | Typical Use |
|-------|-------|------------|
| `space-1` | 4px | Tight grouping (icon + label) |
| `space-2` | 8px | Component internal padding |
| `space-3` | 12px | List item gap |
| `space-4` | 16px | Standard component padding |
| `space-6` | 24px | Section internal spacing |
| `space-8` | 32px | Between components |
| `space-12` | 48px | Between sections |
| `space-16` | 64px | Page-level spacing |

### Rules
- Never use arbitrary pixel values — always use tokens
- Touch targets: minimum 44×44px (accessibility requirement)
- Consistent: same spacing token for the same relationship everywhere (e.g., `space-2` always for label-to-input gap)

## Responsive Breakpoints

| Breakpoint | Value | Target |
|------------|-------|--------|
| `sm` | 640px | Large mobile |
| `md` | 768px | Tablet |
| `lg` | 1024px | Small desktop |
| `xl` | 1280px | Standard desktop |
| `2xl` | 1536px | Large desktop |

### Mobile-First Rules
- Always start with mobile layout, enhance for larger screens
- Touch targets ≥ 44×44px on mobile
- No horizontal scroll on any viewport (min 320px)
- Critical content visible without scrolling on 375px viewport
- Navigation must be accessible on mobile (hamburger, bottom nav, or drawer)

### Responsive Rules per Layer
- **Layout:** Use fluid grids (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`), not fixed widths
- **Typography:** Headings scale down at mobile (`text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl`)
- **Images:** Always use responsive images (`srcset`, `sizes`, `next/image`)
- **Tables:** Horizontal scroll or stack on mobile — never truncate silently

## Accessibility

**WCAG Level:** [AA / AAA]
**Target:** WCAG 2.1 Level AA minimum

### Color Contrast Requirements
| Element | Minimum Ratio | Target Ratio |
|---------|---------------|--------------|
| Normal text (< 18px) | 4.5:1 | 7:1 |
| Large text (≥ 18px bold, ≥ 24px) | 3:1 | 4.5:1 |
| UI components (buttons, inputs, icons) | 3:1 | 4.5:1 |
| Focus indicators | 3:1 | 4.5:1 |

### Interactive Element Rules
- All interactive elements keyboard-navigable (Tab, Enter, Escape, Arrow keys)
- Focus indicator: always visible (never `outline: none` without custom focus style)
- Buttons: always `<button>` or `<a>`, never `<div onClick>`
- Form fields: always associated `<label>` (via `for` attribute or wrapping)
- Images: always `alt` attribute (empty `alt=""` for decorative images)
- Icons (standalone): always `aria-label` on the container
- Modal dialogs: focus trap, Escape closes, background not reachable

### Screen Reader Rules
- Page has a single `<h1>` per route
- Heading hierarchy is logical (h1 → h2 → h3, no skipping)
- Dynamic content changes: use `aria-live` regions
- Loading states: communicate to screen readers (`aria-busy`, `aria-label`)
- Error messages: linked to form field via `aria-describedby`

### Motion Rules
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — wrap all animations in:
  ```css
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { /* animation */ }
  ```
- No animation longer than 400ms for UI feedback
- No auto-playing media without user control

---

## Iconography

**Library:** [e.g., Lucide Icons / Heroicons / Custom SVG]
**Rules:**
- Icons must accompany text for non-obvious actions (never icon-only for complex actions)
- Decorative icons: `aria-hidden="true"`
- Functional icons: either accessible text nearby, or `aria-label` on parent
- Icon size matches surrounding text: `w-4 h-4` with `text-sm`, `w-5 h-5` with `text-base`

---

## Component Patterns

### States (every interactive component must handle all)
- **Default:** Standard appearance
- **Hover:** `cursor-pointer` + visual feedback (color shift, shadow)
- **Focus:** Visible focus ring (never removed, can be styled)
- **Active/Pressed:** Visual confirmation
- **Disabled:** Reduced opacity (≥ 40%), `cursor-not-allowed`, `aria-disabled="true"`
- **Loading:** Spinner or skeleton, `aria-busy="true"`, disable interaction
- **Error:** Error color, error message linked via `aria-describedby`
- **Empty:** Intentional empty state with helpful message

### Form Components
- Always label + input paired
- Error messages: red border + red text message below field + `role="alert"` if dynamic
- Validation: on blur (not on keystroke) for standard fields; real-time for passwords
- Submit button: disabled during submission, show loading state

## Performance Budgets

**Core Web Vitals targets:**
| Metric | Target | Threshold (fail) |
|--------|--------|-----------------|
| LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) | < 2.5s | > 4.0s |
| INP (Interaction to Next Paint) | < 200ms | > 500ms |
| CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) | < 0.1 | > 0.25 |
| FCP (First Contentful Paint) | < 1.8s | > 3.0s |
| TTFB (Time to First Byte) | < 800ms | > 1800ms |

**Bundle size limits:**
| Bundle | Target | Maximum |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Initial JS (gzipped) | < 100KB | 200KB |
| Per-route JS | < 50KB | 100KB |
| Total CSS | < 20KB | 50KB |
| Images (per page total) | < 500KB | 1MB |

**Rules:**
- No layout shift after initial paint — always define `width`/`height` on images and iframes
- Lazy-load images below the fold (`loading="lazy"`, `next/image` with `priority` only for above-fold)
- Font subsetting — only include character sets actually needed
- Third-party scripts: defer or async, avoid in critical path
